app-text/ghostscript-gpl: fix more cross compilation issues Pull in WIP for http://bugs.ghostscript.com/show_bug.cgi?id=696508 The existing patch allowed Ghostscript to compile OK, but Ghostscript still couldn't run correctly. Among other reasons, it was getting bad architecture information (e.g., pointer alignment, sizeof(...)) from the build system via use of a locally-built `genarch` tool, rather than determining them for the target. The upstream work is still stabilizing, but we need it now. It seems to handle most of what we want/need, including making better use of autoconf to determine the target architecture/configuration. bd99955: Improve interrupt / USB charger task wake scheme Previously our charger ISR called a deferred task which woke our charger task. We can skip the deferred task and just wake our charger task directly. The other meaningful change here is to assume that we're using the charger for VBUS detection / BC1.2 if we have a usb_chg task, which holds true for all of our current boards with this charger.
